# greybeam.ai

> > A curated collection of viral internet culture documentation and scientific content, featuring trending memes from TikTok, Know Your Meme, and Scientific American publications.

This site aggregates content focused on understanding viral internet phenomena, social media trends, and scientific storytelling. It covers meme culture from platforms like TikTok, DeviantArt, and Twitter/X, alongside scientific journalism and documentary initiatives.

## Key Topics

- TikTok trends and viral videos
- Know Your Meme documentation
- Exploitable memes and image macros
- Catchphrase memes
- Viral audio and dance trends
- 90s nostalgia and hood movies
- Mental health memes
- Breaking Bad memes
- Scientific American content
- Wildlife conservation documentaries
- Social media platforms (TikTok, Twitter/X, DeviantArt, Facebook)
- Internet culture analysis
- Meme creators and influencers
- Viral reenactment trends

- [Who Is The 'Bananas And Rice' Girl? The Viral Memes About Somali-American ICE Vi... | Know Your Meme](https://trending.knowyourmeme.com/editorials/guides/who-is-the-bananas-and-rice-girl-the-viral-memes-about-somali-american-ice-victim-nasra-ahmed-explained): Guide on Nasra Ahmed ICE detention viral meme from Minneapolis incident

## Viral TikTok Memes

- [I'm Talking About Innit | Know Your Meme](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/im-talking-about-innit): TikTok dance trend based on BunnaB & YKNiece's Atlanta rap song 'Innit'
- [How About A Nice Big Cup of Shut the Fuck Up | Know Your Meme](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/how-about-a-nice-big-cup-of-shut-the-fuck-up): WWII poster-based catchphrase meme trending on TikTok as viral audio

## Exploitable & Image Macro Memes

- [We Still Talk About You | Know Your Meme](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/we-still-talk-about-you): Exploitable meme from DeviantArt art depicting heartbreaking cat imagery
- [Jesse, What the Fuck Are You Talking About | Know Your Meme](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/jesse-what-the-fuck-are-you-talking-about): Breaking Bad dialogue meme featuring Walter White & Jesse Pinkman exchanges

## Meme Collections

- [22 Memes About Mental Health That Are A Little Too Relatable | Know Your Meme](https://trending.knowyourmeme.com/editorials/collections/22-memes-about-mental-health-that-are-a-little-too-relatable): Collection of 22 relatable memes about depression, anxiety & mental wellness

- [Call for Proposals: "The Protectors" A Documentary Series by Scientific American | Scientific American](https://scientificamerican.com/page/call-for-proposals-the-protectors-a-documentary-series-by-scientific-american): $80K grant for wildlife conservation documentary films on endangered species
